text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels in March.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
Fei Ying Ling - (built 1986) 20,330 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5.1 million.
Lion Maru - (built 1981) 22,194 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $4.4 million.
Cornelis Verolme and Ellen Hudig - both (built 1983) 42,077 dwt sold en-bloc to Greek buyers for $10.2 million.
Golden Wing - (built 1989) 42,248 dwt sold within Japan for $16.15 million.
Mare Tirreno - (built 1976) 81,899 dwt sold for $3.1 million.
Kii Maru - (built 1984) 179,422 dwt sold for $15 million.
